title: Move to a new phone: show the code on the old phone
summary: On the signed-in old phone, shows the MSC4108 QR code that a new phone scans to sign in to this account (ADR 0059: the old device shows, the new device scans). After the scan the user types on the old phone the 2-digit number that the new phone shows, then link-phone-approve opens.

support.description: The Bipe support gate of link-computer-scan: the server advertises org.matrix.msc4108 and this phone holds the hidden password. The code shows only when it is supported.

phase.description: preparing: GrantGeneratedQrLoginProgress.starting. showingCode: GrantGeneratedQrLoginProgress.qrReady; the QR code is on screen. enterCheckCode: GrantGeneratedQrLoginProgress.qrScanned; the new phone scanned the code and shows a 2-digit number that the user types here. checking: CheckCodeSender.send runs. failed: see error.

qrBytes.description: QrCodeData.toBytes of qrReady, drawn as a QR code (byte mode, error correction M or higher).

canCopyCode.description: true only in Debug builds or on the iOS Simulator or Android emulator: shows bipe_app_link_phone_copy. false in Release builds on real phones.

checkCode.description: The digits the user typed, at most 2.

error.description: String key of the failed phase: bipe_app_link_phone_expired, bipe_app_link_phone_insecure, bipe_app_link_phone_wrong_check_code, bipe_app_link_phone_needs_recovery_key, bipe_app_link_computer_stopped, bipe_error_network or bipe_error_generic.

open.effect: From Você > Conectar outro aparelho (bipe_app_link_phone_action). Runs the support gate (never Client.isLoginWithQrCodeSupported, ADR 0118). supported: Client.newGrantLoginWithQrCodeHandler, then GrantLoginWithQrCodeHandler.generate with a GrantGeneratedQrLoginProgressListener; sets preparing. needsPin: shows bipe_app_link_phone_needs_pin. notSupported: shows bipe_app_link_phone_not_supported.

update.description: The GrantGeneratedQrLoginProgress case that onUpdate got.

progress.effect: qrReady: keeps qrBytes and sets showingCode. qrScanned: keeps the CheckCodeSender, notes the time of the scan for link-phone-approve and sets enterCheckCode. waitingForAuth: keeps verificationUri and the ContinuationMessageSender and opens link-phone-approve. syncingSecrets and done arrive later, on link-phone-approve.

copyCode.effect: Only when canCopyCode. Puts the base64 text of qrBytes (RFC 4648, with padding) on the clipboard and shows bipe_app_link_phone_copied. For the two-Simulator test: the Simulators share the Mac clipboard.

editCheckCode.effect: Keeps the ASCII digits, at most 2. At 2 digits, runs submitCheckCode.

submitCheckCode.effect: CheckCodeSender.send with the 2 digits as a number (00 to 99); sets checking. A wrong number ends the flow on both phones (invalidCheckCode).

reason.description: The HumanQrGrantLoginError case that GrantLoginWithQrCodeHandler.generate threw.

taskFailed.effect: notFound and expired → bipe_app_link_phone_expired; connectionInsecure → bipe_app_link_phone_insecure; invalidCheckCode → bipe_app_link_phone_wrong_check_code; missingSecretsBackup → bipe_app_link_phone_needs_recovery_key; cancelled → bipe_app_link_computer_stopped; a network failure → bipe_error_network; anything else → bipe_error_generic. Sets failed.

newCode.effect: From failed: drops the handler and runs open again for a new code.

setUpRecoveryKey.effect: From failed with bipe_app_link_phone_needs_recovery_key: opens recovery-key-save.

cancel.effect: Cancels the generate task (ContinuationMessageSender.cancel when one is held) and closes the flow. Nothing changes on the account.

notes: Direction (ADR 0059): the signed-in old phone shows the code and the new phone scans it. A signed-in phone never scans a code to let another phone in, so a person told 'scan my code' has nothing to approve. link-computer-scan is the web exception of ADR 0116 and stays in Settings > Linked devices.

Single entry point: only Você > Conectar outro aparelho opens this screen. The code is never sent, shared or saved; bipe_app_link_phone_never_share shows under it. The copy button exists only in Debug builds and on the Simulator or emulator, where no camera works (bipe-chat/bipe#608). iOS gate: #if targetEnvironment(simulator) || DEBUG. Android gate: BuildConfig.DEBUG or an emulator build (Build.FINGERPRINT generic, Build.HARDWARE goldfish or ranchu).

The check code goes the other way round from link-computer-scan: the new phone shows it (QrLoginProgress.establishingSecureChannel) and the user types it here. It proves that both phones share the channel. A wrong number stops the flow; the user makes a new code.

Time: the Synapse rendezvous session lives about 60 seconds (registries/accounts.json webLinkCooldownSeconds comment). The scan, the check code, the warning, the biometric check and the MAS page of link-phone-approve must fit in it. An expired session ends as notFound or expired; newCode makes a new code.
Keep the screen awake while the code shows (iOS isIdleTimerDisabled, Android FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON) and draw the code on a white field with a quiet zone, in light and dark mode.
missingSecretsBackup: this phone has no recovery key and key backup, so the new phone cannot get the history. The user sets up the recovery key first (recovery-key-save).
